reason: I already carry a bottle I like and fill it from the tap, so I've mostly stopped buying bottled water anyway. Paying close to $70 up front plus a filter subscription to replace something that works isn't a good trade for me, and tossing a new bottle and a stream of plastic filters doesn't feel very green either.
objection: I already have a bottle that works, and I don't know what these filters are made of, what they actually remove, or whether I can recycle them. A subscription for plastic cartridges feels like it cuts against why I care about this.
would_change_my_mind: A filter I could buy on its own to fit my current bottle, or a recycling take-back for used filters plus clear independent test results on what it removes.
